parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is the leg part of the pliers, made of steel. It forms one of the two arms that pivot to open and close the jaws.
parts.Functional_description: The leg transmits the force applied by the user’s hand to the jaws, enabling gripping, cutting, or bending of materials.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other leg, allowing the jaws to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the pliers, typically made of plastic for insulation and comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable grip for the user and insulates against electrical conductivity when working with wires.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed to the leg part and moves together with it during operation, pivoting around the joint.
